name: Aino Nieminen
bio:
Aino's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, not on the track, but in the complex algorithms of Nokia's research labs. After contributing to groundbreaking data analysis projects there, she realized the immense potential of applying similar techniques to racing. Leaving the corporate world, she initially volunteered her skills to local Finnish rally teams, quickly earning a reputation for unearthing hidden performance gains through rigorous data interpretation. 

Her approach is meticulous and data-driven. Aino believes that every lap, every tire change, every minute detail holds valuable information that can be leveraged to optimize performance. She focuses on identifying patterns and correlations that others might miss, translating raw data into actionable insights. What sets Aino apart is her deep understanding of both the technical aspects of racing and the human element, allowing her to bridge the gap between engineers and drivers.

Now a highly sought-after free agent, Aino brings not only her advanced analytical skills but also her unwavering loyalty and dedication to any team she joins.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly styled bob with a slight wave
physical.description: Aino has a kind face with a few fine lines around her eyes that speak of years spent analyzing data.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically against her desk when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to classical music while working to maintain focus.
